meta.tagline: Discover the hidden places of Saudi Arabia
meta.description: A travel guide to Saudi Arabia's 13 regions: heritage sites, mountains, deserts and coastlines. Track the places you visit on your own travel passport.

home.title: Discover the Saudi Arabia most travellers never see
home.subtitle: Ancient tombs, painted mountain villages, coral islands and endless desert. Plan your trip, save places and colour in your travel passport as you go.
home.regionsSubtitle: From the Red Sea to the Gulf, every region has its own character.
home.passportText: Mark the places you visit and watch your map of Saudi Arabia fill with colour. Sign in to keep it safe across all your devices.

transport.title: Getting around Saudi Arabia
transport.subtitle: Flights, trains, buses, taxis and driving: how to travel between cities and regions.
transport.verify: Routes, timetables and rules change. Check with the airline, train operator or official sites before you travel.
transport.distancesNote: Approximate road distances. Allow extra time for mountain roads.
transport.localTravelText: Most places are best reached by car, taxi or ride-hailing app. For desert and off-road sites, join a tour.
